title: Mother and Son at Sunny Beach, 1950 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny summer snapshot taken in July 1950 showing a mother and her young son wading in the ocean surf with other beachgoers swimming in the background. The mother wears a patterned halter-neck swim dress and sunglasses, while the boy wears floral-patterned swim trunks and a sun scarf tied over his head. The photo captures the optimism, leisure, and family vacation culture of post-WWII mid-century America.
